directed_tree_reconstruction.description: Directed binary-tree hierarchy reconstruction from Figure 5. The paper reports this result qualitatively: symmetric baselines do not reveal hierarchy direction and distort distances, while Finsler MDS reveals the hierarchy direction and highly preserves distances.

normalized_stress.description: Continuous directed-distance reconstruction error on the scored source-node rows.

map_at_10.description: Mean average precision of the top directed-neighbour rankings induced by predicted distances.

asymmetry_rmse.description: Error in the antisymmetric distance component, penalizing methods that fit only symmetric structure.

asymmetry_correlation.description: Correlation between predicted and target directional distance components.

symmetric_rmse.description: Error in the symmetric distance component, guarding against methods that preserve direction while losing geometry.

hierarchy_alignment.description: Spearman alignment between the recovered final coordinate and tree depth.

distance_preservation_pass.description: Graded threshold-clearance score for directed-distance reconstruction error; zero means the qualitative Figure 5 threshold was not cleared.

asymmetry_preservation_pass.description: Binary check that directional-distance error clears the qualitative Figure 5 threshold.

hierarchy_direction_pass.description: Binary check that hierarchy-coordinate alignment clears the qualitative Figure 5 threshold.

directed_tree_depth5_reconstruction.description: Additional directed binary-tree hierarchy reconstruction setting matching Figure 5's various-depth tree setup.
